//: jash + Claude Code — drop into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global).
//sigil: JASH_SIGIL=2 → every agent command is recorded in the attested BLAKE3 chain + Ed25519-signed, so recall/dashboard/rewind work and the run is provable.
//nudge: JASH_NUDGE=1 → after a failure, jash suggests the differential that would have helped (drives adoption). Set 0 to silence.
//budget: JASH_LLM_BUDGET → huge command output overflows to a recall-able file (context governor) instead of blowing your window. 131072 = 128k.
//hooks: ADR-0037: the SessionStart hook injects the jash agent field guide into the model's context at t=0 — the only deterministic way the agent learns it is in jash (rules files depend on someone pasting them; runtime tips arrive too late). Without this, agents assume bash and bypass every differential.
